Samir: Short follow-up from today's all-hands — capturing the hiring & pod realignment Qs. I'll keep answers tight.
Priya: Thanks. First up: is this a hiring freeze or a reprioritization?
Samir: It's reprioritization. We're pausing low-priority reqs for ~60 days to preserve runway and invest in infra, runtime, SRE, and model-serving. Revenue/SLA roles continue.
Javi: To be explicit: Eng gets a small pool of additional HC for Q2 (mostly infra/platform). Manager hires limited unless it's a backfill for an internal promotion.
Noah: What happens to offers already extended but not signed?
Priya: Open offers will be reviewed case-by-case. Signed offers remain valid. Recruiting will reach out to affected candidates this week.
Carla: Contractors — renewals or wind-down?
Mina: Priority to renew contractors who are critical to product ops. Non-critical renewals will be deferred or evaluated against strategic needs.
Noah: If my pod loses a req, how will folks be treated? Redeploy or layoffs?
Priya: First step: 10 business day internal redeploy window. Managers propose matches; people can state preferences. If no internal fit, we'll follow separation policy with support resources.
Carla: Promotions and comp adjustments — still on track?
Priya: Promotions continue. Comp pool trimmed modestly; we'll prioritize retention and market-critical adjustments. Exceptions for retention cases ok — submit via People Ops.
Mina: Interview loop changes: non-strategic roles may move to a condensed loop (1 panel + take-home). Senior/platform roles keep full loop.
Samir: Exceptions for SLA/customer-blocking roles: submit a 2-line justification to people-ops + your lead and CC me. We'll triage within 48 hours for fast-track.
PeopleOpsBot: Reminder: HR office hours Fri 10am PT in #people-ops for impacted teams. Calendar invite sent.
AllhandsBot: Note: Consolidated follow-up doc uploaded to team-docs/all-hands/2026-06-hiring-reprioritization.pdf :page_facing_up:
Priya: We'll publish a provisional pod map and HC per pod by Monday EOD so managers can plan. Thanks for keeping questions short — feel free to DM for private concerns. :pray:
